_comment: Natural prompts for the agent-offload-coverage harness. The point is to test whether c-thru's INJECTED descriptions alone make Claude choose the right subagent — so prompts must NOT name an agent or say 'use the Task tool'. `expect[0]` is the primary agent; the rest are acceptable alternates (selection is non-deterministic). Placeholders {{PY}}, {{PLAN}}, {{DIR}} are substituted with scratch paths by the harness.

prompts.prompt: Review the code in {{PY}} for security vulnerabilities and report what you find.
prompts.note: security framing should prefer the security reviewer over the routine one

prompts.prompt: I want to add token-bucket rate limiting to an HTTP API service. Plan how to approach it before any code is written.
Write thorough unit tests for the functions in {{PY}}.
The function in {{PY}} returns the wrong result for some inputs. Figure out the root cause.
prompts.note: debugging framing — any debugger tier is fine

prompts.prompt: Find where and how the code under {{DIR}} validates its inputs. Just locate it; don't change anything.
Implement a function in {{PY}} that merges two already-sorted integer lists into one sorted list.
Write clear API documentation for the module in {{PY}}.
Here is a plan file: {{PLAN}}. Review it for gaps, risks, and missing steps before implementation.
Give me a one-paragraph summary of what {{PY}} does.
prompts.note: lightweight one-shot — may legitimately answer inline (no-offload is informative)

prompts.prompt: Do a careful code review of {{PY}} and flag correctness, style, and edge-case issues.
